Haiku Generator

Generate 5-7-5 haikus from syllable-counted word banks — every line is guaranteed the right syllable count.

📖 How to use

  1. Press Generate haiku.
  2. Read your 5-7-5 poem.
  3. Generate again or copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is 5-7-5 guaranteed?

Lines are assembled from words with known syllable counts, so 5-7-5 is exact every time.

What words are used?

A bank of nature- and season-flavored words in 1, 2 and 3 syllable groups.

Will I get a different haiku each time?

Yes — lines are assembled randomly from the syllable-counted word banks, so every haiku is unique.
